artifacts.summary: Confirms conclusion-stage.md Step 4b is the sole broken meta-builder-agent dispatcher of three; finds meta-builder-agent.md's defensive target_root fallback predates both diagnosis dates (stale premise); settles the deploy-path file_scope convention as legitimate; recommends remedy (a) plus a refusal-based strengthening of the existing fallback plus a new standing siting rule distinct from the specs/** artifact-location exemption.

memory_candidates.content: When a dispatch's own diagnosis cites an agent file's behavior ('has no resolution step', 'silent cwd fallback'), verify against git blame/log before accepting it as current: contract text can be measurably stale (added, then superseded by a same-day follow-up commit that the diagnosing text was never updated to reflect) even when the diagnosis itself is well-evidenced for the specific incident it measured.

A cross-repo task's file_scope declaring both a source-store path and its deployed .claude/** mirror is not an authoring overload when the task's description mandates a redeploy step: the redeploy genuinely rewrites the mirror, so both paths are truly touched by the task's execution. The convention is asymmetric by which repo owns the source store -- the owning repo may declare the source path alone (its own .claude/** is disposable); a deploy-only repo should declare both for overlap-gate visibility.
